answer: Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 126 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the cedar ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the nectar review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A near-duplicate is rejected at the lotus gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
